zh.title: 波音777-9試飛突破5,100小時、1,800架次　華航亦訂購777X客貨機
zh.summary: 波音777-9試飛機隊累計超過5,100小時、1,800架次；華航已訂購15架777-9及8架777-8F，關注777X認證進展。
body: 波音（Boeing）公布，旗下777-9廣體客機試飛機隊截至2026年11月5日，已累計超過5,100飛行小時、完成逾1,800架次飛行，達成777X計畫的另一項測試里程碑。上述數據為整支777-9測試機隊的累計成果，並不代表該機型已完成認證或開始商業營運。
對照波音7月16日公布的資料，當時777-9試飛機隊累計超過4,800小時、約1,700架次，且原廠表示已完成約50%的預定認證測試。最新飛行時數與架次顯示測試仍在持續推進；不過，波音11月的公告並未更新整體認證測試完成比例，無法單憑累計飛行時數推算目前進度。
除了在美國進行測試，777-9也持續前往不同地區驗證性能。波音指出，一架試飛機近期首次飛抵冰島凱夫拉維克國際機場（KEF），使冰島成為該機型試飛活動造訪的第10個國家。團隊在當地的主要任務是側風條件測試，藉此蒐集航機在不同天氣與操作環境下的性能數據。
儘管試飛總量增加，777-9仍須完成剩餘的型別認證程序。波音7月曾表示，部分型別檢查授權（TIA）及雙發延程飛行（ETOPS）相關驗證尚待推進；第三季申報文件亦提到，部分認證測試階段與GE9X發動機耐久性問題的解決方案仍需主管機關核准。波音目前仍以2027年交付首架777-9為目標，實際時程取決於後續測試及監管審查。
臺灣航空業者同樣關注777X計畫進展。中華航空於2025年5月與波音正式宣布訂購10架777-9客機及4架777-8F貨機，另有5架777-9與4架777-8F選擇權；根據華航其後公布的公司資料，2025年已將這9架選擇權全數轉為正式訂單，使777X家族確定訂購數量增加至15架777-9客機及8架777-8F貨機，合計23架。這些訂單包含不同型號，不能將23架全部計入777-9客機。
華航表示，777-9將用於北美、歐洲等長程高運量客運航線，777-8F則將與現有777F貨機配合營運。該公司2025年5月簽約時預計777X新機隊自2030年起陸續交付；這是華航個別的機隊引進規劃，與波音目前對全球首架777-9在2027年交付的目標不同，實際交機仍受認證與生產進度影響。
777-9是波音777X系列的長程雙發廣體客機。波音表示，777X系列全球累計訂單已超過660架，並宣稱777-9相較其取代的上一代機型可改善約20%的燃油效率。這些是原廠公布的產品與訂單資訊，其中訂單數涵蓋777X系列各型號，不能全部視為777-9訂單。

en.title: Boeing 777-9 test fleet tops 5,100 hours and 1,800 flights; China Airlines orders passenger and freighter variants
en.summary: Boeing's 777-9 test fleet has exceeded 5,100 hours and 1,800 flights. China Airlines holds firm orders for 15 777-9s and eight 777-8Fs.
body: Boeing said on November 5, 2026, that its 777-9 flight-test fleet had logged more than 5,100 flight hours across more than 1,800 flights, marking another milestone for the 777X program. These are fleet-wide cumulative totals; they do not mean the aircraft has received type certification or entered commercial service.

In a July 16 update, Boeing had reported more than 4,800 flight hours and approximately 1,700 flights, with around 50% of planned certification testing completed at that time. The newer totals show further flight-test activity, but Boeing's November announcement did not provide an updated certification-completion percentage. Flight hours alone cannot establish the remaining certification work.

The 777-9 is also being tested in different operating environments. Boeing reported that a test aircraft recently visited Keflavik International Airport (KEF) in Iceland for the first time, making Iceland the tenth country reached by the program's flight-test aircraft. Crosswind conditions were the focus of the Iceland visit.

The aircraft still needs to complete remaining certification activities. In July, Boeing identified further Type Inspection Authorizations and extended-range twin-engine operations (ETOPS) demonstrations among outstanding work. Its third-quarter filing also described regulatory approvals still needed for later testing phases and a solution addressing a GE9X engine durability issue. Boeing continues to target the first 777-9 delivery in 2027, subject to testing and regulatory approval.

Taiwan's China Airlines is among the 777X family customers watching the program's progress. In May 2025, the airline announced firm orders for ten 777-9 passenger jets and four 777-8 Freighters, with options for five additional 777-9s and four 777-8Fs. China Airlines subsequently said those nine options were converted to firm orders in 2025, bringing its firm 777X commitment to 15 passenger 777-9s and eight 777-8F freighters, or 23 aircraft across the family. The 23-aircraft total must not be mistaken for an order solely for 777-9 passenger aircraft.

China Airlines expects to deploy the 777-9 on high-capacity long-haul services to North America and Europe, while the 777-8F will complement its existing 777F cargo fleet. At the May 2025 signing, the airline said deliveries of its new 777X fleet were expected to begin in 2030. That airline-specific delivery plan is distinct from Boeing's 2027 target for the first 777-9 delivery to any customer, and remains subject to certification and production progress.

The 777-9 is a long-range, twin-engine widebody member of Boeing's 777X family. Boeing says the wider 777X family has accumulated more than 660 orders worldwide and claims the 777-9 offers roughly 20% better fuel efficiency than aircraft it replaces. The order total covers the 777X family, not solely the 777-9.

facts.claim: On Nov 5, Boeing said the 777-9 flight-test fleet exceeded 5,100 flight hours and 1,800 flights.
Boeing reported a first 777-9 visit to Iceland, the 10th country, to conduct crosswind tests at Keflavik.
On July 16, Boeing reported more than 4,800 test hours, about 1,700 flights, and 50% of planned certification testing completed then.
Boeing's Q3 filing targets 2027 initial delivery and notes testing and GE9X durability work requiring regulatory approval.
Boeing says over 660 777X aircraft have been ordered and claims a 20% fuel-efficiency improvement for 777-9.
China Airlines' official company sustainability site states it converted five 777-9 and four 777-8F options into firm orders in 2025, bringing firm totals to 15 and eight aircraft.
China Airlines announced ten 777-9s and four 777-8Fs in May 2025, with nine options; it planned 777X fleet deliveries beginning 2030.
